## Summary (Ask Bunkankun 聞分館君)

This 1-fascicle text by [智肱](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E8%82%B1) Zhìgōng is a Buddhist liturgical worship-eulogy (*lǐ zàn wén* 禮讚文) honoring [澄觀](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%BE%84%E8%A7%80) Chéngguān (the *Qīngliáng guóshī*) — the fourth Huáyán patriarch and the most important Tang Huáyán-school authority. The text functions as a devotional liturgy used in Sòng-Yuán-Míng Huáyán monastic worship of the school's patriarchs.

**Abstract**

The bracket adopted here (1050 – 1100) reflects [智肱](https://ask.bunkankun.org/Persons/%E6%99%BA%E8%82%B1) Zhìgōng's mature Northern-Sòng activity in the lineage of *Chángshuǐ Zǐjùn*. The work documents the Sòng Huáyán-school's ritualisation of its own patriarchal lineage — the same impulse that produced the *qī zǔ xíng jì* 七祖行蹟 list of seven patriarchs ([J B005](https://ask.bunkankun.org/KR6/KR6e/KR6e0073)) and the related Sòng-period Huáyán-lineage literature.

The work is preserved in the Manji *Xù zàng jīng* (X1471) collection.
